subject: Equinox RFP — Control Inventory & Artifact Pickup Plan
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@equinox.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Equinox Procurement <procurement@equinox.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Equinox RFP: initial control questionnaire and timeline

Ben / Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is the Equinox RFP questionnaire (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SIG sections) we mentioned on the call. We need a control-level mapping and artifacts to support the SOC 2 and ISO claims. High-level asks: 

- A completed control crosswalk mapping our questionnaire rows to Redwood controls (identify control owner and artifact name).
- Samples of artifacts for cryptographic key management, encryption-at-rest, and privileged access reviews.
- A short one-page SOC 2 summary we can include in the RFP package.

Our timeline is tight — procurement deadline is 2026-12-15. Can you confirm a plan for intake, collection, and delivery (ideally by 2026-12-10)? Also confirm if you need any PO/NDA before sharing artifacts.

Attached: Equinox_RFP_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Senior Sourcing Manager
Equinox Financial
laura.chen@equinox.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@equinox.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Equinox RFP: initial control questionnaire and timeline

Laura —

Appreciate the clear outline and the deadline. We can support this. Proposed plan below:

1) Intake kickoff call: 2026-12-02 10:00 AM PT (30m) — confirm scope, owners, and sensitive artifact handling.
2) Redwood delivers a draft control crosswalk and SOC 2 one-pager by 2026-12-05.
3) Artifact handoff window: 2026-12-06 to 2026-12-09 (we will upload artifacts to a secure Share link and provide signed access controls).
4) Final packaged deliverables by 2026-12-10 for your procurement review.

We will include a mapping to SOC 2 CC and ISO 27001 clauses as well as SIG rows where applicable. For any artifacts that contain customer data (logs, backups), we will provide redacted samples and an artifact attestation letter.

Attachments we are preparing for you now: 
- Redwood_RFP_Control_Map_v1.xlsx (control map + ownership)
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf (concise control posture summary)

A couple of quick Qs: do you require evidence to be delivered under an NDA or via your secure upload portal? Also, if Equinox requires key management artifacts from a KMS provider (HSM/KMS), we can provide architecture diagrams and KMS attestation samples rather than raw keys.

Ben Carter
Head of Security Solutions (RFPs)
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_RFP_Control_Map_v1.xlsx]
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf]
From: Ahmed Raza <ahmed.raza@equinox.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@equinox.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Equinox RFP: initial control questionnaire and timeline

Ben / Mina —

Quick clarifying question on encryption and key management: in question set Q22–Q24 we asked for evidence of encryption-at-rest and key rotation procedures. Would it be possible to receive:

- A sample KMS configuration export or a redacted KMS policy showing key rotation schedule (redact key material).
- The diagram that shows flow of keys for Redwood Private deployments (how customer keys are stored/rotated if using customer-managed KMS).

Also, is there an existing SOC 2 bridge letter or date for the most recent report? That helps our legal team triage whether they need to request the full report vs. a summary + attestation.

Thanks,
Ahmed
Security Sourcing – Equinox
ahmed.raza@equinox.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ahmed Raza <ahmed.raza@equinox.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@equinox.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Equinox RFP: initial control questionnaire and timeline

Ahmed / Laura —

Thanks for the specifics — below are direct answers and what we will include in the artifact package.

1) KMS / Encryption artifacts:
- We will provide a redacted KMS policy export showing key rotation cadence, IAM bindings for KMS access, and a sample key-version history (no key material).
- For Redwood Private customers who use customer-managed keys, we will attach the architectural diagram that shows the KMS interaction model (customer KMS -> Redwood runtime -> disk encryption). The diagram will be labeled and redactions applied where appropriate.

2) SOC 2 report / bridge letter:
- We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2026-06-30. For RFP purposes we can provide the SOC 2 summary + a signed attestation letter. If Equinox requires the full report under an NDA, we can route that via DocuSign/NDA and a controlled Share access.

3) Control crosswalk deliverable: attached is a first-pass crosswalk mapping the questionnaire rows to Redwood controls, SOC 2 criteria, and ISO clauses. The crosswalk includes suggested artifact file names and the control owner within Redwood. See column notes for examples of acceptable artifact formats (PDF attestation, architecture diagram, execution logs).

Action items we are taking now: 
- Deliver redwood_control_crosswalk_EQX_v1.xlsx (attached) by end of day 2026-12-03.
- Prepare a redaction checklist and upload plan for artifacts (expected upload 2026-12-06).
- Schedule the kickoff call for 2026-12-02 10:00 AM PT (invite sent).

If procurement requires the NDA before any artifact is shared, please route the DocuSign link and we will sign promptly.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Customer Assurance
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_control_crosswalk_EQX_v1.xlsx]
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@equinox.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Equinox Procurement <procurement@equinox.com>, Ahmed Raza <ahmed.raza@equinox.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Equinox RFP: initial control questionnaire and timeline

Team —

This looks good and thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement will issue the NDA via DocuSign today and we've scheduled the kickoff for tomorrow (invite in calendar). Once we receive the signed NDA, we'll confirm the secure upload location. Please proceed with the crosswalk and SOC 2 one-pager as discussed.

We appreciate the redaction approach for any sensitive artifacts — that should be fine for our review. Aim to have the artifact bundle in place by 2026-12-09 so we have time for legal review.

Best,
Laura

--
Laura Chen
Senior Sourcing Manager | Equinox Financial
